core_meaning.primary_meaning: Haajar is an Arabic-origin name meaning “To emigrate”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Haajar corresponds to the Arabic form هاجر (Arabic root ه ج ر (h-j-r); هاجر (Hājar)). Its core sense is hagar; she who emigrated, one who migrates. Haajar is Arabic هاجر (Hājar), the name of Hagar, mother of Ismāʿīl — from the root ه ج ر 'to emigrate', so 'she who emigrated'. The source gloss 'the one who perseveres' reflects her story rather than the lexical sense. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave حجر ('stone') as the Persian form of this name.

persian.name: هاجر
persian.long_meaning: Haajar (هاجر) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن هاجر؛ مهاجرت‌کننده است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: हाजिरा

pashto.name: هاجر

arabic.name: هاجر
